versions.changelog: Tighten env var safety: reject OPENCLAW_HOME/WORKSPACE set to home root ($HOME) — must be a strict subdirectory. Clarify required vs optional: only python3 is hard required; env vars and shred are optional with documented defaults. Qualify 'files you create remain untouched' claim with env var scoping caveat.

Make session ID the primary scrub anchor to prevent cross-session collateral. Replaced mtime-primary scrubbing with two-tier strategy: (1) remove lines explicitly referencing ghost session IDs, (2) only apply mtime+timestamp heuristic when file mtime is within the ghost window. Files unconnected to the ghost session are now skipped entirely.

Harden env var safety: verify OPENCLAW_WORKSPACE/HOME resolve within user home dir at startup, aborting if misconfigured. Fix validate_path boundary check. Clarify cooperative write suppression model in docs.

Fix overly broad SQL index cleanup and silent verify failure: anchored LIKE patterns to path component boundaries (%/<id>.% OR %/<id>/%), treat DB errors as verification failures instead of silent pass

Address ClawHub security scan feedback: promote requires/install to top-level frontmatter, add install.scripts list, add missing validate_path() calls in ghost_scrub.py, replace manual path traversal check with validate_session_id() in ghost_archive.py

Bug fixes: add missing import os in ghost_archive.py and ghost_verify.py (was causing NameError). Harden verify layers 5 & 6 to do actual content checks for session ID references instead of assuming scrubber completed.

Fix metadata format: use flat string arrays for requires.env and requires.bins per ClawHub spec (fixes 'Required env vars: none' mismatch). Add shred to required bins. Soften credential example to avoid implying secret exfiltration.

Safety hardening: env var declarations in metadata, dry_run_by_default now true (destructive ops default to preview), path validation prevents operations outside workspace, session ID path traversal protection, documented cooperative flag and heuristic limitations.

Safety interlocks: confirmation prompt before deletion (--yes to skip), --dry-run mode to preview without changes, auto-created config enforcing confirm_before_delete on new installs. Strengthens auditability and prevents accidental data loss.
Initial release: incognito mode for OpenClaw agents. Pause memory writes, scrub all traces on exit.
